groups.saying_opens: حرم رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم نبيذ الجر
قال صدق حرم رسول الله صلى الله عليه

notes: «- المعنى -» and «- يعني ابن حكيم -» are editor glosses between dashes: left out
two sayings: Ibn Umar's report of the prohibition, and Sa'id's question to Ibn Abbas, whose answer («قال صدق») is Ibn Abbas's own words (rule 5 and 6)
«قال كل شىء يصنع من مدر» is Ibn Abbas's explanation of the same exchange; it is part of the second saying, not a new link
